features.title: Everything You Need to Understand Your World
features.description: From raw geospatial data to stunning visual insights — Maplytics puts the power of spatial intelligence in your hands.

cards.title: Rich Datasets, Ready to Explore
cards.description: Dive into our curated library of public geospatial datasets covering regions, cities, and boundaries — or bring your own. Upload custom datasets in standard formats and instantly unlock spatial analysis tailored to your exact needs.

cards.title: Just Describe What You Want to See
cards.description: No complex query syntax. No steep learning curve. Simply type what you want to visualize in plain language, and Maplytics intelligently translates your intent into precise spatial queries and visual outputs — instantly.

cards.title: Stunning Maps & Interactive Charts
cards.description: Turn your data into interactive maps, heatmaps, bar charts, scatter plots, and more. Every visualization is dynamic, responsive, and shareable — giving your team the clarity needed to make confident, data-driven decisions.
bullets: Export and share with your team

howItWorks.title: How to Start
howItWorks.description: From Raw Data to Visual Clarity in 3 Simple Steps

steps.title: Create Project
steps.description: Start by choosing from our rich library of public geospatial datasets, or upload your own. Supports GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefiles, and more — your data is ready in seconds.

steps.title: Input Prompt
steps.description: No SQL. No complex filters. Just type your question in plain language and Maplytics intelligently translates it into precise spatial queries — instantly.

steps.title: Explore Interactive Visualizations
steps.description: Get beautiful, interactive maps, heatmaps, bar charts, and scatter plots instantly. Share your insights with teammates or export them for presentations and reports.

cta.title: Start Turning Your Geospatial Data into Actionable Insights Today
cta.description: Join researchers, analysts, and planners who use Maplytics to understand their cities — no coding experience required.
cta.trustLine: No credit card required · Free to get started · Saudi-focused data
